Name: Beatles Albums
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Tahoma]Have you ever felt like your pixelated farming game was lacking in 60s boy band content? Now you'll never have to feel that way again with the [b][u]Beatles Albums[/u][/b] content pack!

[size=4]Content[/size]
Decorate your house with wall decor featuring pixel art renditions of all Beatles albums as well as the solo albums from all four members. There are a total of 85 albums to choose from, all created by hand, it's not just squished-down PNGs![/font]

[font=Tahoma]There are two versions of this mod available to choose from with the same content available; please pick one that works best for you. The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] version adds the albums as new, completely separate furniture. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36168]Vinilla's Album Catalogue[/url] installed, they will appear there; otherwise they'll show up in the regular Furniture Catalogue. This version also offers configs for each artist's discography. Only want stuff from John Lennon's solo career? You can make that happen![/font]

[font=Tahoma]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version allows you to change the appearance of any 32x32 vanilla painting with the paint bucket tool into an album of your choosing. The AT version has no interaction with Vinilla's Album Catalogue and there's no way to choose which albums you get.

[size=4]Installation and Removal[/size]
Can be installed and uninstalled like any other mod, by unzipping into your Mods folder. If using the AT version, albums will revert to their "true appearance" after uninstalling. CP version albums will turn into error items which can be thrown away.


Check out my [url=https://vinillavin.neocities.org/]neocities[/url] if you enjoyed my mod! Thanks for checking it out[/font]
